posts.text:
We might well be witnessing the #COMEX Silver end game. Sell Silver down as far as possible, and call for a default to cover. Only a few billion will be needed to settle the outstanding contracts of the ‘silver shorts’

As said during my panel presentation in Zurich yesterday, the current crash is a ‘gift from God’. Being able to buy Silver under $50 a last time (which is the same price as 45 years ago).

Short term anything can happen, long term silver needs to be trading much higher (due to the supply and demand fundamentals). The physical silver market might be cleaned out soon. Then the market reverses, and all silver stocks will do 5-10x

posts.text:
When I’ve had a great run in the markets I start feeling anxiety.  I physically begin to note the stress and unease in my stomach.   It’s my early warning system telling me I’m about to fall on bad times.  

If it’s been a really good long run. Then I get really stressed. I fear it’s gonna be a bad, upsetting, depressing 6-9 months.

When I’ve been bludgeoned for weeks or months I actually start feeling good.  I know that things are going to be looking up soon. 

I currently feel fantastic cause things are so grim.  Everything I bought today is underwater…. Everything i own has had a pretty nasty 1/2 year or so.  

But I’m starting to feel extremely optimistic.  I think its going to be an amazing 6-9 months ahead.
